events.verdict: Sabonis (IND) firms up in a screening position in Tatum's (BOS) path and does not deliver the contact.
Horford (BOS) firms up in a screening position in Collison's (IND) path and does not deliver the contact.
Sabonis (IND) moves laterally into Horford's (BOS) path and makes contact to the body that affects his SQBR.
Sabonis (IND) maintains a legal guarding position on Irving's (BOS) shot attempt.
Sabonis (IND) jumps A to B and makes body contact with Horford (BOS) before the start of his upward shooting motion.
Morris (BOS) is the first of multiple players from both teams to enter the lane before the release of the free throw.
Oladipo (IND) makes marginal contact with Smart (BOS) going after the pass and knocks the ball out of bounds.
Collison (IND) sets the screen on Tatum (BOS) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Oladipo (IND) gathers the ball and takes more than two steps during his step-back.
Collison (IND) and Horford (BOS) briefly engage and disengage following the pick.
Sabonis (IND) has his arms extended when he engages with Morris (BOS) during the pick but the contact is marginal when he disengages.
Brown (BOS) trips Oladipo (IND) and the contact affects his driving shot attempt.
Sabonis (IND) has a legal hand placed on Horford's (BOS) back when he receives the ball in the post.
Irving (BOS) and Joseph (IND) engage and disengage and Joseph briefly grasps Irving's jersey without affecting his SQBR.
Joseph (IND) legally contests Irving's (BOS) shot attempt at the basket.
Oladipo (IND) cleanly deflects the inbound pass.
Irving (BOS) and Oladipo (IND) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Tatum (BOS) establishes himself in a screening position in Joseph's (IND) path and does not deliver the contact.
